name: 最初のグラフを選ぶ候補一覧
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
One actual catalog component only, no dashboard or presentation board.
REFERENCE HIERARCHY: ORIGINAL source images have priority for icon glyph geometry, proportions, stroke/optical weight, alignment, spacing, small controls and visible states. Native mock is SECONDARY for Japanese adaptation and isolated component composition; correct its rough substitutes and omissions against the original. The approved bus image is a style reference only, not content.
Official Lighthouse design: pure-white#FFFFFFpage/canvas; white surfaces; fine neutral borders and restrained soft shadow only where a real container exists. Forest-green brand#1F6444with smooth#174C36to#2D8F5Egradient on actual primary/selected controls. Supporting icons coherent slate#526173, no random decorative hues. Use only evidence-backed semantic accents. No broad mint wash, glow or plastic gloss. Preserve Japanese Meiryo typography: headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24, metadataRegular12/16, zero tracking; retain role-specific distinctions and normal-weight body. Preserve all actual values, content, controls, artwork and visible states. Do not invent metrics, features, logos or watermark. Apple Design: purpose, compact readable hierarchy, precise alignment, clear state and restrained material. This static raster does not prove interaction, editability or owner acceptance.
Input roles: Image1: original-source-primary-details; Image2: component-preview-secondary; Image3: approved-style-reference
One complete first-chart candidate picker, logical740x622, TWOcolumns and THREErows exactlysix cards. Purewhite canvas. Heading最初のグラフを作りましょう Bold20/28. Six equal white rounded cards fine neutralborder restrained softshadow. Each header small generic slate eventcross mark within white neutraloutline circle, as intentionally authorized nativecatalog adaptation (do not copy Amplitude logo). Japanese heading labels rowwise: ページの表示; セッションの開始; 利用中のイベント; すべてのイベント; 成果のイベント; 新しい利用者. Respect ORIGINAL source counts: firstcard 過去24時間に7件, second 過去24時間に3件, remainingfour 過去24時間に0件. Mock repeats7 incorrectly, do not repeat error. Body descriptions respective: ページを読み込んだ時の記録; 利用を始めた時の記録; 利用中の操作をまとめた記録; 送信された操作をすべて表示; 目的に達した時の記録; 初めて利用した人の記録. Preserve Japanese Meiryo: heading20/28bold, cardtitles14/24bold, description12/16regulargray, totals14/24regularink. Each card bottom thin forestgreen sparkline: long flatbaseline with narrow rightend peaks matching ORIGINAL shape, no axes or invented metrics. Different original sparkline peakshapes should be retained for eachcard, avoid mock identicaltwopeaktriangles. No mint wash, no coloredtopicicons, no controls beyond six selectablecards. All6cardsandtext complete, no clipping. ORIGINAL controls actual counts and finechartgeometry, mock secondaryJapanese content.
Evidence-based accent decision: No category palette or selected state. Ordinary eventcross markers coherent slate onwhite small neutraloutline circles; chartseries use consistent forestgreen adapted from sourceblue. Whitecards neutralborder rounded and softsmallshadow; pagewhite, no mintborders.
reviewNotes: 原画・日本語モックを実見。誤った全件7を原画7/3/0/0/0/0へ修正し6枚と全文を保持。記録済みの汎用イベント十字への意図的置換を維持。白・中立境界・緑系列。出力実見済みだが各スパークラインが同じ山形へ均質化され原画固有の波形を保持できず要修正。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
